description.en: Sensor-equipped beehives on the 42 campus. Outside, 2026 swung from about −5 °C in winter to more than 30 °C in summer. Inside, from spring on, the colony keeps the brood at around 35 °C, heating on cold days and cooling on hot ones, with no electronics.

environment.en: Shows how a colony buffers heat that the city around it cannot.

description.en: Large green area in the urban environment with a playground and sports facilities. A good example of how a city can create green space for recreation.
The bridge becomes a central block of green, with planting that promotes biodiversity and cycle lanes in both directions that connect to the existing network.

environment.en: Green structures improve the urban climate on the bridge.

description.en: For a trial period of three months the bridge is closed to motor vehicles, except for buses.

environment.en: Less car traffic means less noise and fewer emissions on the bridge.

title.en: Wellbeing Oasis at the Robert Mayer Monument

description.en: The area around the monument is upgraded with new trees, shrubs and perennials, creating two green zones in the urban space.

environment.en: Provides shade and improves the microclimate on the market square, one of the city's heat hotspots.

description.en: The Wollhaus rooftop becomes the WOW-haus, showcasing greening, water retention and energy generation. The exhibition "Heilbronn – European Green Capital" takes place on the ground floor.

environment.en: Shows sustainable urban development on a real rooftop.
